_meta.purpose: Trade measures and regulations that change the documents, duties or risk of a shipment. Each entry has an effective date, a source and a 'last_verified' date. The Monitor step re-checks the sources and raises alerts when something changes.
_meta.warning: Duty RATES are never stored here as final truth. The agent links to the live official tariff (TARIC for the EU, HTS for the US) for the shipment date.
_meta.scope: v2.3: rule packs for all goods (CE products, export control, food/plants, deforestation, CBAM, trade defence); construction rules stay. Indicative HS prefixes: a specialist confirms scope.

measures.name: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) - definitive regime
measures.effect: Importers of more than 50 tonnes of CBAM goods per calendar year must be authorised CBAM declarants, buy CBAM certificates and surrender them for the embedded emissions (first annual declaration in 2027 for 2026 imports).

documents.name: Authorised CBAM declarant number (if > 50 t of CBAM goods per year)
Embedded-emissions data from the producer/installation

measures.name: EU steel import measure (replaces the steel safeguard): tariff-rate quotas, 50% out-of-quota duty, melt-and-pour evidence
measures.effect: Duty-free volumes are limited by country quotas (total about 18.3 million tonnes per year); imports above the quota pay 50%. Importers must prove where the steel was melted and poured (e.g. mill certificate). Check whether the product is in one of the 30 product categories of Annex I.

documents.name: Mill certificate showing the country of melt and pour

measures.name: EU anti-dumping and anti-subsidy duties (depend on the country of origin)
measures.legal_ref: Regulation (EU) 2016/1036 and 2016/1037 (basic regulations); specific measures published in TARIC
measures.effect: Extra duties can apply to specific products from specific countries. They change often. The agent links to TARIC for the exact CN code, origin and date.

measures.name: Construction Products Regulation: CE marking and Declaration of Performance (and Conformity)
measures.legal_ref: Regulation (EU) 2024/3110 (general application from 8 Jan 2026), replacing Regulation (EU) No 305/2011 step by step
measures.effect: Construction products covered by a harmonised standard need CE marking and a Declaration of Performance (DoP), or the new Declaration of Performance and Conformity (DoPC), depending on the applicable technical specification during the transition. Importers must check both before placing the product on the EU market.

documents.name: Declaration of Performance (DoP / DoPC)
CE marking evidence (label or photo)

measures.name: REACH: Safety Data Sheet for hazardous substances and mixtures
measures.effect: Hazardous substances and mixtures (chemicals, paints, adhesives, mortars, sealants) need a Safety Data Sheet in the language of the country where they are sold (German for Germany). Whether a product is hazardous is decided by its classification (CLP), not by the HS code.

documents.name: Safety Data Sheet (SDS, in German for the German market)

measures.name: Timber due diligence (EU Timber Regulation, to be replaced by the EU Deforestation Regulation)
measures.legal_ref: Regulation (EU) No 995/2010 (EUTR); Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 (EUDR) - check the current application date
measures.effect: Wood and wood products need due-diligence evidence on legal harvest (and, under EUDR, deforestation-free origin with geolocation).

documents.name: Timber due-diligence statement / supplier evidence

measures.name: EU-Turkiye customs union: proof for preferential treatment
measures.legal_ref: Decision No 1/95 of the EC-Turkey Association Council; ECSC products under the EU-Turkiye free trade agreement
measures.effect: Industrial goods in free circulation in Turkiye use the A.TR movement certificate. Steel products (outside the customs union) need an origin proof such as EUR.1 to claim a preference.

documents.name: A.TR movement certificate (or EUR.1 for steel products) to claim preferential treatment

measures.name: US Section 232 duties on steel, aluminium and derivative products
measures.legal_ref: Section 232, Trade Expansion Act of 1962; presidential proclamations (changed several times in 2025-2026)
measures.effect: Articles made (almost) entirely of steel or aluminium pay 50%; since 6 Apr 2026 the duty is calculated on the full value of the product. Rates and product lists change often.

documents.name: Country of melt and pour / smelt and cast declaration

measures.name: US general import surcharges after the Supreme Court IEEPA ruling
measures.legal_ref: Supreme Court, Learning Resources v. Trump (20 Feb 2026) ended IEEPA tariffs; replaced by a temporary surcharge under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974 (max. 150 days unless Congress extends)
measures.effect: A general surcharge on top of the normal duty may or may not apply on the shipment date. Always check the live HTS and Federal Register.

measures.name: Machinery: CE marking and EU Declaration of Conformity
measures.legal_ref: Directive 2006/42/EC; replaced by Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which applies from 20 Jan 2027
measures.effect: Machines placed on the EU market need CE marking, an EU Declaration of Conformity and instructions in the language of the country (German for Germany). From 20 Jan 2027 the new Machinery Regulation applies. Spare parts are usually not machines themselves: a person checks.

documents.name: EU Declaration of Conformity (machinery) + CE marking
Instructions for use in German

measures.name: Electrical and radio equipment: CE (LVD, EMC, RoHS, RED) and WEEE registration in Germany
measures.legal_ref: Directives 2014/35/EU (LVD), 2014/30/EU (EMC), 2011/65/EU (RoHS), 2014/53/EU (RED), 2012/19/EU (WEEE); in Germany ElektroG (registration with stiftung ear)
measures.effect: Electrical and electronic products need CE marking and an EU Declaration of Conformity. Whoever first places them on the German market must be registered for WEEE (ElektroG) and show the WEEE registration number.

documents.name: EU Declaration of Conformity (LVD / EMC / RoHS / RED) + CE marking
WEEE registration number (ElektroG, Germany)

measures.name: Batteries Regulation: CE marking, labelling and producer registration
measures.legal_ref: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (applies since 18 Feb 2024); in Germany BattDG (registration with stiftung ear)
measures.effect: Batteries, also inside products, need conformity documentation, labelling and CE marking; the producer (often the importer) must be registered in Germany before placing them on the market.

documents.name: EU Declaration of Conformity (batteries) + CE marking
Battery producer registration (BattDG, Germany)

measures.name: Export control: possible dual-use item (EU control list)
measures.legal_ref: Regulation (EU) 2021/821, Annex I as updated by the Delegated Regulation of 8 Sep 2025 (adds semiconductor manufacturing and testing equipment)
measures.effect: The goods may be on the EU dual-use list. Exports outside the EU can need a licence (in Germany from BAFA). The HS code alone never decides: an export-control specialist checks the technical parameters against Annex I.

documents.name: Export-control classification (Annex I entry or 'not listed') by the exporter
Export licence from BAFA, if the item is listed

measures.name: US export controls (EAR): US-origin items and re-exports
measures.legal_ref: Export Administration Regulations, 15 CFR Parts 730-774 (Commerce Control List, ECCN)
measures.effect: Items made in the US (and some foreign items with US content) keep US export-control rules, also when re-exported from Germany. The supplier's ECCN is needed; some destinations and end users need a US licence.

documents.name: ECCN from the US supplier (or EAR99)

measures.name: Food, feed, animals and plants: official border controls
measures.effect: Many food, feed, animal and plant products must be notified in advance (CHED in TRACES) and may need health or phytosanitary certificates and a border control post. Outside KlarSchiff's reviewed scope: a specialist decides.

documents.name: CHED pre-notification (TRACES) / health or phytosanitary certificate, if required

measures.name: EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR): due-diligence statement
measures.legal_ref: Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 as amended in Dec 2025: applies from 30 Dec 2026 (large and medium operators) and 30 Jun 2027 (micro and small)
measures.effect: Cattle, cocoa, coffee, oil palm, rubber, soya and wood products need a due-diligence statement (reference number) proving deforestation-free and legal production, with geolocation of the plots. Main headings only: check Annex I of the regulation.

documents.name: EUDR due-diligence statement reference number
